_comment: Canonical copy of the site-page default content that exists in BOTH backend/app/schemas/site_pages.py (DEFAULT_SITE_PAGES) and frontend/src/features/site-pages/defaults.js (SITE_PAGES_DEFAULTS). The API value wins the frontend's merge, so the two copies must not drift. Both test suites assert against this file: backend/tests/test_site_pages_defaults_parity.py and frontend/src/features/site-pages/__tests__/defaultsParity.test.js. Editing a default? Change all three places in one commit — either side's CI fails otherwise.
